author: cobratrinity@proton.me
description: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative survival crafting game. This variant preloads RSDWServerAPI, which adds a REST API, RCON, in-game admin chat commands and a Discord chat/death relay.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SteamCMD Base Installation Script

# Variables
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "Using anonymous Steam login"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
fi

cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz

tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

export HOME=/mnt/server

# Install server
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit

# Fix steam libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

# Permissions for Sentry Crash Handler
chmod +x /mnt/server/RSDragonwilds/Plugins/Developer/Sentry/Binaries/Linux/crashpad_handler 2>/dev/null || true

# Seed DedicatedServer.ini (first install only, so reinstalls keep ServerGuid and AdminList)
INI_DIR=/mnt/server/RSDragonwilds/Saved/Config/LinuxServer
if [ ! -f "${INI_DIR}/DedicatedServer.ini" ]; then
    echo "Creating default DedicatedServer.ini"
    mkdir -p "${INI_DIR}"
    cat <<'EOF' > "${INI_DIR}/DedicatedServer.ini"
[SectionsToSave]
bCanSaveAllSections=true

[/Script/Dominion.DedicatedServerSettings]
AdminPassword=
OwnerId=
WorldPassword=
ServerName=
DefaultWorldName=
ServerGuid=
EOF
fi

# RSDWServerAPI (REST API / RCON / Discord relay mod, preloaded by the startup command)
# Installed from a GitHub release on every (re)install: "latest", a pinned tag, or "manual"
# to keep a librsdwapi.so you uploaded yourself. A failed download keeps the current build.
RSDWAPI_REPO=${RSDWAPI_REPO:-CobraTrinity/RSDWServerAPI}
RSDWAPI_RELEASE=${RSDWAPI_RELEASE:-latest}
mkdir -p /mnt/server/rsdwapi

if [[ "${RSDWAPI_RELEASE}" == "manual" ]]; then
    echo "RSDWServerAPI: release set to manual, keeping the existing librsdwapi.so"
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL=${RSDWAPI_URL}
    DIGEST=""
    if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]]; then
        if [[ "${RSDWAPI_RELEASE}" == "latest" ]]; then
            API_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${RSDWAPI_REPO}/releases/latest"
        else
            API_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${RSDWAPI_REPO}/releases/tags/${RSDWAPI_RELEASE}"
        fi
        # Pick the asset by name: librsdwapi.so, else any .so, else a (linux) zip.
        ASSET=$(curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "${API_URL}" | jq -c '
            [ (.assets[] | select(.name == "librsdwapi.so")),
              (.assets[] | select(.name | test("\\.so$"))),
              (.assets[] | select(.name | test("(?i)linux.*\\.zip$"))),
              (.assets[] | select(.name | test("\\.zip$"))) ] | first // empty')
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "${ASSET}" | jq -r '.browser_download_url // empty' 2>/dev/null)
        DIGEST=$(echo "${ASSET}" | jq -r '.digest // empty' 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^sha256://')
    fi

    if [[ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]]; then
        echo "RSDWServerAPI: no release asset found in ${RSDWAPI_REPO} (${RSDWAPI_RELEASE}), skipping"
    else
        echo "RSDWServerAPI: downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
        rm -rf /tmp/rsdwapi && mkdir -p /tmp/rsdwapi
        SO=/tmp/rsdwapi/download
        if ! curl -fsSL -o "${SO}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
            echo "RSDWServerAPI: download failed, keeping the current build"
            SO=""
        elif [[ -n "${DIGEST}" ]] && [[ "$(sha256sum "${SO}" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "${DIGEST}" ]]; then
            echo "RSDWServerAPI: download does not match the release's SHA-256, keeping the current build"
            SO=""
        elif unzip -tq "${SO}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            unzip -oq "${SO}" -d /tmp/rsdwapi/x
            SO=$(find /tmp/rsdwapi/x -type f -name 'librsdwapi.so' | head -n 1)
            [[ -n "${SO}" ]] || echo "RSDWServerAPI: the zip has no librsdwapi.so, keeping the current build"
        fi
        if [[ -n "${SO}" ]] && [[ "$(head -c 4 "${SO}" | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" == '177ELF' ]]; then
            install -m 0755 "${SO}" /mnt/server/librsdwapi.so
            echo "RSDWServerAPI: installed ($(stat -c %s /mnt/server/librsdwapi.so) bytes)"
        elif [[ -n "${SO}" ]]; then
            echo "RSDWServerAPI: the download is not a Linux shared library, keeping the current build"
        fi
        rm -rf /tmp/rsdwapi
    fi
fi
[[ -f /mnt/server/librsdwapi.so ]] || echo "RSDWServerAPI: librsdwapi.so is missing, the server will start without the API"

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Owner ID
variables.description: Your in-game RuneScape: Dragonwilds Player ID, a 32-character code shown at the bottom of the in-game Settings menu. This is NOT your Steam ID. Required: the server will not create a world without an owner.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name of your server. The in-game server browser only shows the first 16 characters.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password that grants admin rights to whoever enters it in-game under ESC > Settings > Server Management. Do not reuse the World Password.

variables.name: Default World Name
variables.description: The name of the world to create/load

variables.name: World Password
variables.description: Optional world password. Leave empty for public access.

variables.name: Beacon Port
variables.description: UDP world settings beacon port (Jagex default: 8888, the game port + 1111). Add an allocation for this port on the same IP as the game port, or players cannot reach it.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server (1-6)

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Check for and install server updates on every startup (1 = on, 0 = off)

variables.name: Extra Arguments
variables.description: Additional server startup arguments. The required logging flags are already part of the startup command.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam App ID for Dragonwilds server

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI Repository
variables.description: GitHub owner/repo whose releases provide librsdwapi.so. Applied on (re)install.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI Release
variables.description: Release to install: 'latest', a tag to pin (e.g. 0.1.6), or 'manual' to keep a librsdwapi.so you uploaded. Reinstall the server to update the mod.

variables.name: RSDWServerAPI Download URL
variables.description: Optional direct link to librsdwapi.so or a zip containing it. Overrides the repository and release.

variables.name: API Port
variables.description: TCP port of the REST API. Needs its own allocation.

variables.name: API Bind Address
variables.description: 0.0.0.0 to reach the API through its allocation; 127.0.0.1 to keep it inside the container.

variables.name: API Bearer Token
variables.description: Token for the REST API. Leave empty to use the one generated on first start (rsdwapi/settings.ini).

variables.name: API IP Whitelist
variables.description: Comma separated addresses or CIDR blocks allowed to use the API. Empty allows everyone with the token.

variables.name: RCON Enabled
variables.description: Source RCON listener (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: RCON Port
variables.description: TCP port for RCON. Needs its own allocation when RCON is enabled.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Leave empty to use the one generated on first start (rsdwapi/settings.ini).

variables.name: Discord Relay Enabled
variables.description: Relay chat, joins and leaves to a Discord webhook (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Discord Webhook URL
variables.description: Discord webhook for chat, joins and leaves.

variables.name: Discord Death Webhook URL
variables.description: Optional separate webhook for player deaths.
